T015 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (YEucl n)),
  ((0 ≤ dimH E ∧ dimH E ≤ ↑n ∧ dimH E < ∞) ∧
      (n = 0 → E = Set.univ ∧ E.Subsingleton ∧ dimH E = 0) ∧ ∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → YContent s δ E < ∞) →
    (n = 0 → dimH (YF E) ≤ dimH E + 1) →
      (1 ≤ n → ∀ (q : ℝ), dimH E < ENNReal.ofReal q → YHaus (q + 1) (YF E) = 0 ∧ dimH (YF E) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (q + 1)) →
        dimH (YF E) ≤ dimH E + 1
'Translation.T015' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
